notes: Only fully closed 1H candles as of trade entry or completed 4H signal. BTC manual journal matched one-to-one to completed 4H DeltaRSI transition within 4 hours, descriptive selection analysis, not out-of-sample proof. Features use 1H close prior to event, no future data. Volume public Bybit linear contract, if available, otherwise null. All comparisons exploratory and correlated; no significance claims. Signals before warmup excluded.
